description.value:
Applied by No Vacancy to the target.

Immune to possession, mind-reading, and mental control of any kind for the duration; thoughts read to prying spirits as flat static.

cinderfall.incomplete: Built per this corpus's own hollowbound.shut-the-door / shut-the-door-effect pattern (spell stays rules: [], a companion Effect item carries the mechanic) and pf2e-source's own spell-effect-arcane-explosion.json (a real Immunity rule element on a duration-limited Effect item). possession and mental are both real, confirmed IWR types (pf2e-source/src/scripts/config/iwr.ts:84, :68); mental blocks anything carrying the mental trait (mind-reading and mental-control effects both do), so this single Immunity type covers all three effects the spell describes without over- or under-covering them.
